about_the_game:
EVERDAWN is a peaceful strategy and puzzle game where you place tiles to shape ever-growing, enchanting landscapes. Step into a serene world where nature flourishes, and take a quiet moment to unwind and build at your own pace.

Whether you're here to relax or looking for a challenge, EVERDAWN adapts to your playstyle: every tile matters, and thoughtful planning is key to reaching high scores. Create lush forests, harmonious villages, or mysterious wilderness, your world, your rhythm, endless possibilities.


Made by a lone developper, EVERDAWN is a unique mix of strategy and puzzle with a peaceful, immersive atmosphere. Shape an ever-expanding world tile by tile, balancing aesthetics, logic, and score chasing.
A meditative game for some, a strategic challenge for others.

Each session begins with a stack of randomly generated tiles: draw them one by one, rotate them, and connect forests, rivers, villages, and more to shape a unique world. Smart placement earns you points, unlocks new tiles, and extends your run.

Quests & Wonders
From the very start, take on random quests across three categories:
- Common: easy to complete, perfect for steady progress.
- Rare: more challenging but far more rewarding.
- Wonders: unique objectives granting access to one of 9 powerful Wonders that can radically change your strategy with unique bonuses.

Clusters & Synergies
Create clusters, interconnected groups of tiles. The more elaborate your connections, the greater the rewards. Will you favor opportunistic plays or long-term planning?

Biomes & Visual Variety
Advance through Adventure Mode to unlock new biomes, each changing the appearance and gameplay of your tiles. Create fresh combinations in every run.

Progression

- Expand your world tile by tile and complete optional objectives.
- Unlock biomes, new tiles, and unique combinations.

Exploration

- No timer: play at your own pace or chase the highest score in different game modes.
- Grow living landscapes with forests, fields, rivers, and much more.

Gameplay

- Place and rotate tiles, form clusters, and complete quests to earn bonuses.
- Easy to pick up, hard to master: accessible yet deep.

Atmosphere

- Soothing and immersive soundtrack, varying depending on the game mode.
- Colorful, evolving visuals that reflect the growth of your world.

Replayability

- Random tile draws guarantee unique sessions.
- Simply create or push for the best score.
